t: Skado village, Naxos
s: It is hypothesized that the name is derived from the numerous fig trees (Greek - Sykies) that surround the village. Skado is one of the emery producing villages of Naxos and inhabitants have shares in the mines they work. Until the Second World War, the village had not developed farming since its economy relied on mining.
